title: Programme
description: A named course of study leading to a credential. One Programme becomes several Opportunities when its intake, campus, language or admissions rules differ.

credential.description: What the qualification is, on three axes kept deliberately apart: a coarse cross-country LEVEL for comparing, the LOCAL TITLE as actually awarded, and the SECTOR in the local system’s own vocabulary. The reasoning is in src/lib/credentials.mjs. Presentation may branch on structure and comparableLevel, which are finite and cross-country, and may never branch on a country.

comparableLevel.description: Coarse on purpose. A student comparing four countries needs to know whether this is the normal first degree, shorter than one, or the long one ending at master’s level — not a twenty-value ladder.

structure.description: How the programme is built, which changes a student’s decision more than its name does.

localTitle.description: Exactly as awarded, in the local language. “Diplomingeniør”, not “professional bachelor of engineering”. This is what the certificate says and what an employer will be shown.

localTitleEn.description: An English rendering shown BESIDE the local title, never instead of it.

abbreviation.description: BSc, BEng, LLB, and so on, where one is used.

sector.description: What kind of institution, in its own terms. A Fachhochschule is not a university, not a polytechnic and not a college, and flattening it into any of those loses what a student needs to understand.

local.description: The local sector name: erhvervsakademi, Fachhochschule, grande école.

eqf.description: European Qualifications Framework level, where the country publishes one.

title.description: Deprecated: superseded by localTitle and localTitleEn. Kept so older records still validate.

level.description: Deprecated: the original Denmark-shaped enum, superseded by comparableLevel.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences. A seventeen-year-old should finish it knowing whether this is for them.

structure.description: Learning fit — how the degree actually works, which matters as much as whether you qualify.

family.description: One programme a student sees, offered as more than one path: the same subject at one institution as two credentials, on two campuses, or as a named specialisation. Members share one card; each keeps its own record and page. Checked by src/lib/families.mjs (docs/research/variants/design.md).

id.description: Shared by every member. Not a programme id.

name.description: The card's title, the same on every member.

axis.description: What the paths differ on. Checked: a campus family must span campuses, a credential family must award different credentials.

admission.description: Whether the members' requirements differ. Checked against the Opportunities' requirements, so a family can never hide an admission difference behind one card.

path.description: This path's short label: “Bachelor of Engineering”, “Herning”, “XR specialisation”.

differs.description: One line: what is different about this path, and nothing that is the same on every path.

primary.description: Exactly one member is true: the card links to it and shows its picture.

separateFrom.description: Programmes at the same institution whose names look like this one but which are deliberately separate cards, with the reason a student must act on.
